item.title: Highlights from TexWorld Paris 2024 and Our Commitment to Collaboration
item.description:
TexWorld Paris 2024: Connecting the Global Fashion Industry
#

Twice a year, TexWorld Paris brings together over a thousand exhibitors from across the fashion industry, creating a dynamic sourcing platform for professional buyers worldwide. The event showcases a broad spectrum of products, ranging from essential basics to the most innovative and high-quality materials.

item.title: Sustainable Materials and Innovative Solutions for a Greener Future
item.description:
Embracing Nature to Nature: Our Commitment to Sustainable Materials
#

At AceGreen Eco-Material Technology, we are dedicated to advancing the use of sustainable materials and innovative processes. Our philosophy, “Nature to Nature,” reflects our determination to create products that respect and preserve the environment while meeting the needs of modern industries.
